name: Support Bot 6: Weekly Report
description: Mondays 8:00 am Boston time: emails the owner last week's chats, bookings, hand-offs and errors, plus the unanswered questions grouped into themes with suggested lines to add to the shop info doc.

parameters.text:
=Customers asked the Copperline Auto Repair chat assistant these questions this week, and its shop info could not answer them:
{{ $json.questions_text }}

Group them into themes. Return one line per theme in exactly this format, with no other text:
Theme | number of questions | one sentence the owner could paste into the shop info doc

Write the sentence as the shop ("We ..."), with any fact the owner has to fill in shown as a choice or blank in brackets, for example: We [do / do not] offer window tinting[, from $___]. Never invent prices or policies. If the list is (none), return nothing.

options.systemMessage: You help a small auto repair shop owner keep their chat assistant's shop info complete. Be brief and practical.

parameters.content:
## Weekly Report
Every Monday at 8:00 am (Boston time) the owner gets one email: chats, messages, bookings by service, hand-offs by reason, and errors for the last 7 days.

Questions the assistant could not answer are grouped into themes by GPT-5.4 mini, each with a suggested line to add to the shop info doc. The AI returns plain text and the email is built and escaped in code, so customer text cannot inject HTML.

Automated test sessions (`eval-`, `check-`) are left out.
